name: Kayako
description: Kayako is an AI help desk platform whose Kay AI agent classifies, prioritizes, routes, and drafts replies to support tickets, either as a standalone helpdesk or layered on top of existing systems.
best_for: SaaS, retail, financial services, and healthcare organizations with high ticket volumes looking to reduce support costs and speed up resolution.

tiers.name: Kay AI Agent (usage component)
tiers.notes: Only charged when Kay fully resolves a ticket without human involvement; escalations and partial resolutions are free. This is the only dollar figure Kayako publishes on its pricing page.

tiers.name: Kayako One (full platform)
tiers.notes: Base per-agent seat price is not disclosed on the official pricing page as of 2026-09-26 — every plan button reads Talk to a Pricing Expert or Request a Demo.

cons: Base platform seat pricing for Kayako One is not disclosed anywhere on the official pricing page — the only public number is the $1-per-AI-resolution usage fee, and every visitor is pushed to book a sales call to learn the actual per-agent cost.
No free trial is mentioned on the pricing page, unlike most helpdesk competitors that advertise self-serve trials — evaluation requires a sales conversation.
The AI resolution fee is uncapped and volume-unbounded, with no published cap, tier, or volume discount, so cost scales linearly and unpredictably as support volume grows.
features: Kay AI agent that classifies, prioritizes, and drafts replies to tickets
Omnichannel inbox consolidating email, chat, social, and voice
Native knowledge base with semantic search
No-code workflow automation for routing and assignment
SLA management and real-time resolution analytics
Deployable as an AI layer on top of Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, or Salesforce
SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and SSO/SAML enterprise security

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: A customer service platform with ticketing, live chat, and AI-powered automation.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams of all sizes needing an established, feature-rich helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Freshdesk
alternatives.description: A cloud-based help desk with ticketing, automation, and omnichannel support.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams wanting an affordable, easy-to-deploy helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A shared inbox and help desk platform built for personalized, human-feeling support.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized support teams wanting simple, email-centric ticketing.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation
